card: This PR fixes a flaky CI failure in functional test wallet_conflicts.py by adding mempool synchronization after transaction broadcasts. Previously, if peer nodes requested a transaction after Alice had already replaced it, the replacement race caused divergent mempools across nodes, resulting in a 40-minute mempool sync timeout. The PR resolves this race condition and cleans up a redundant sync call. It affects only functional tests.
evidence: The PR description cites a CI failure log showing `wallet_conflicts.py` failing with `AssertionError: Mempool sync timed out after 2400s:` because node 1 held two transactions while nodes 0 and 2 held only one.
problem: In `wallet_conflicts.py`, transactions tx1 and tx3 do not conflict with each other, but tx2 replaces tx1. If peer nodes request tx2 from Alice only after Alice has already replaced it with tx3, they never receive tx2 and instead end up retaining both tx1 and tx3. This causes subsequent `sync_all()` calls during block generation to time out after 2400 seconds because nodes hold divergent mempool sets.

risk.why: It only touches functional test synchronization in wallet_conflicts.py, so a bug would at most cause the test to fail.

summary: Fixes an intermittent CI timeout failure in functional test `wallet_conflicts.py` by synchronizing mempools between transaction broadcasts. It also removes a redundant post-generation sync call and adjusts which node generates the final cleanup block.
